question: The Dancer Couple Dhananjayans were awarded the Rashtriya Kalidas Samman Award (2019 - 2020) for their contribution to which Indian dance form?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest and most prominent classical dance forms of India.
 
• This dance form originated in **Tamil Nadu** and has its roots in **Natya Shastra**, an ancient Sanskrit text on performing arts written by **Bharata Muni**.
 
• Bharatanatyam represents **expressive storytelling** through intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions, often depicting themes from **Indian mythology**.
 
• The art form was initially performed in temples as a form of **devotional offering** to the deities and later evolved into a respected performance art.
 
• The Dancer Couple **V.P. Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan** are renowned exponents of Bharatanatyam and have contributed significantly to its global recognition.
 
• The Rashtriya Kalidas Samman Award recognizes their **lifelong dedication** to preserving and promoting this classical dance tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam**__

 __
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form that originated in **Kerala**, India.
 
• It is characterized by **graceful and flowing movements** and is often referred to as the **dance of the enchantress**.
 
• The dance focuses on **expressive gestures** and is performed solo by women.
 
• Mohiniyattam draws inspiration from **Hindu mythology**, particularly the story of Mohini, the female avatar of Lord Vishnu.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**__
 __
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **North India**.
 
• The term "Kathak" is derived from the word "**Katha**", meaning story, and the dance often involves **storytelling** through intricate footwork and spins.
 
• Kathak has three main gharanas or schools: **Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras.**
 
• This dance form combines elements of **Hindu and Mughal cultures** and is performed both in temples and courts.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**__
 
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form that originated in **Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is named after the village **Kuchipudi**, where this dance form was developed.
 
• Kuchipudi involves a mix of **dance, acting, and singing**, making it unique among Indian classical dances.
 
• The dance form often incorporates themes from **Hindu mythology**, including stories of Lord Krishna, Lord Rama, and other deities.
